title: Binance Reveals How Fake Job Interviews and AI Tool Abuse Led to $6.43 Billion Theft
summary_en: Binance on Tuesday said the record-setting theft of $6.43 billion in assets from the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange was the culmination of a "sophisticated, multi-stage campaign" that involved the use of a tampered Homebrew installation and recruitment-themed social engineering attack targeting two of its engineers.
